title: Madeira or the Canary Islands: Which Is Better for Boat Trips?
description: Madeira suits short private trips under tall cliffs, from a marina in the city centre. The Canaries win on sand beaches and Tenerife's resident pilot whales.
heroAlt: Two guests on a private boat looking at the steep green cliffs between Ribeira Brava and Ponta do Sol
keywords: Madeira or Canary Islands for boat trips
which is calmer Madeira or Canaries

images.prompt: Mid-afternoon in spring, seen from the middle of the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, the boat moving slowly parallel to the shore. Two guests seen from behind and small lean on the side rail, looking at the steep south coast of Madeira between Ribeira Brava and Ponta do Sol: high green and brown cliffs, terraces of banana plants on the lower slopes, a few white houses with orange roofs, and a narrow dark pebble shore at the foot with no sand beach. Calm deep blue sea, soft sun from the west, true colours, no text, no logos.
images.alt: Two guests on a private boat looking at the steep green cliffs between Ribeira Brava and Ponta do Sol

images.prompt: Terraced banana plantations climbing a steep slope above the sea on Madeira's south coast, small white houses among them, seen from the water in late afternoon light, no people.
images.alt: Banana terraces on a steep slope above the sea on Madeira's south coast
